name: fits a simple threshold split
test:
import numpy as np
X = np.array([[0.0], [0.2], [0.8], [1.0]])
y = np.array([0, 0, 1, 1])
model = ExtraTreeClassifier(max_depth=2, min_leaf=1, n_features=1, n_thresholds=20, seed=1).fit(X, y)
assert model.predict(np.array([[0.1], [0.9]])).tolist() == [0, 1]

name: constant features fall back to majority class
test:
import numpy as np
X = np.ones((5, 3))
y = np.array([1, 1, 1, 0, 0])
model = ExtraTreeClassifier(max_depth=4, min_leaf=1, seed=3).fit(X, y)
assert model.predict(np.ones((2, 3))).tolist() == [1, 1]

name: min_leaf prevents tiny child splits
input: split would create a one-row leaf
test:
import numpy as np
X = np.array([[0.0], [1.0], [2.0]])
y = np.array([0, 0, 1])
model = ExtraTreeClassifier(max_depth=4, min_leaf=2, n_features=1, n_thresholds=10, seed=0).fit(X, y)
assert model.predict(np.array([[2.0]])).tolist() == [0]
